'''Cedric Juniper's assistants''' are a group of people who work with [[Cedric Juniper]] on his researches.

==History==
The assistants first appeared in ''[[BW117|Team Plasma's Pokémon Manipulation!]]'', where Cedric Juniper urged them to continue with their excavation.

In ''[[BW120|Ash and N: A Clash of Ideals!]]'', the assistants managed to find a sealed door with hieroglyphs on it and wondered if the [[Light Stone]] is inside. Later, when {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt|Team Plasma grunts}} attacked the {{an|White Ruins}}, they were surrounded by the grunts' {{p|Liepard}} and ultimately abducted. 

Later, in [[BW121|the next episode]], the abducted assistants heaved a sigh of relief that the [[Light Stone]] is safe.

With [[BW122|the transformation of the Light Stone into Reshiram and defeat of Team Plasma]] behind them, the assistants claimed to a distressed Cedric Juniper that they have managed to excavate some ice ruins and requested his assistance on their survey; the excavation group then set off towards their new destination.
